js
const KEY = 'dsh-structured.tone'
export function loadTone() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY)
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_TONE
    return parseTone(JSON.parse(raw)) ?? DEFAULT_TONE
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_TONE // fail-open
  }
}
